subject: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — roles, network & KMS owners
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Hughes <nhughes@pharoshealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <talvarez@pharoshealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — roles, network & KMS owners

Hi Natalie / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our agreement, I’m kicking off the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Private/VPC deployment of Redwood at Pharos Health. I attached a lightweight MAP worksheet and a short network checklist to help surface the immediate dependencies.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–40 min):
- Quick intros + internal ownership (5 min)
- Architecture constraints: VPC topology, NAT, subnets, peering/VPN options (10 min)
- Security responsibilities: KMS key owner, key rotation, audit/log access (10 min)
- Timeline & next milestones: test VPN, staging deploy, data flow validation (5–10 min)

Requests / asks before the call:
1) Please confirm the primary technical contacts for networking and for KMS/key management (names and emails).
2) If you have an existing network diagram or CIDR ranges, upload or share a link.
3) Any procurement or legal gating items we should add to the MAP (SOW signers, PO cadence).

Internal owners I’m proposing:
- Laura Bennett (Solutions Delivery) — deployment runbook and staging sign-off
- Dev Patel (Infrastructure) — VPN & topology testing
- Priyom Das (Security Eng) — IAM/KMS integration and audit scopes

If that team looks good, I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for later this week. I’ve tentatively penciled Sept 16 10:00–10:30 PT; say if you prefer another window.

Attachments: redwood-map-initial.xlsx (MAP worksheet), PH-network-checklist.pdf (network pre-check)

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Vivek —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick answers:
- Networking contact: Jamie Lee (IT Ops) — it-ops@pharoshealth.com (will handle VPN and firewall rule uploads).
- KMS/key owner: Evan Brooks (Security Lead) — ebrooks@pharoshealth.com (Evan manages our AWS KMS and rotation policy).
- We uploaded a first-pass network diagram and CIDR list to the shared Drive (link below).

We can do the kickoff Sept 16 at 10:00 PT. Tom and I will be on; Jamie will join for the networking part and Evan will join for the KMS discussion.

Note: procurement wants a reviewed SOW and an estimated internal timeline before we finalize the PO. Happy to include procurement on the next MAP update — cc mean: procurement@pharoshealth.com if needed.

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — roles, network & KMS owners

Great — thanks for confirming. Meeting is set for Sept 16, 10:00–10:30 PT; calendar invite sent.

I’m updating the MAP worksheet with the contacts you provided and a tentative milestone plan. Quick proposed milestones (high-level):
- Sept 16: Kickoff (introductions, confirm owners) — DONE
- Sept 20: Provide network ACLs / firewall rule list and test VPN window (owner: Jamie)
- Sept 24: Staging deploy (Redwood) and hello-world inference test (owner: Laura)
- Sept 28: End-to-end dataflow validation + KMS key exchange (owner: Evan + Dev)
- Oct 5: Production cutover readiness review (mutual sign-off)

Action items I’m taking now:
- Laura: will draft a staging runbook and handoff checklist.
- Dev: will prepare VPN test harness and remote access instructions.
- Priyom: will prepare IAM/KMS integration checklist and required logs/audit scopes.

Please take a look at the timeline and tell us if any dates are blocker/too aggressive. Also attaching the MAP worksheet and checklist again.

Vivek

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Hughes <nhughes@pharoshealth.com>, Jamie Lee <it-ops@pharoshealth.com>, Evan Brooks <ebrooks@pharoshealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — roles, network & KMS owners

Folks —

A couple of prep notes from Redwood delivery side before staging:
- VPN options: we support site-to-site IPsec and AWS Transit Gateway peering. If Pharos prefers short-term client VPN for initial testing, that’s fine but we’ll ask for a plan to migrate to a permanent peering before prod cutover.
- Certificates & KMS: Evan — we’ll need the public key metadata and whether you want Redwood to generate wrapping keys or bring-your-own (BYOK) with your KMS. Priyom and I will align on the required IAM roles.
- Network tests: please share a target EC2 (or NAT) endpoint we can use for ping/tcp checks. Jamie, if you can provide a test window (2 hours) next week, Dev will run connectivity tests and collect traceroutes.

Deliverables I'll publish by Sept 20: staging runbook (PDF), firewall rule template (CSV), and a validation checklist.

Laura Bennett
Principal Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Jamie Lee <it-ops@pharoshealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — roles, network & KMS owners

Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the plan. I’ve uploaded a more detailed network diagram and our CIDR allocation to the Drive link you provided (pharos-network-diagram-v1.pdf). For the VPN test window: Sept 21, 13:00–15:00 PT works for us.

Firewall rule note: we’re behind a NAT and will need source/destination ports for the control plane and for the inference egress. I’ve attached a short csv with the baseline ports (will also paste to the shared sheet).

One more note on KMS: Evan confirmed he will be the KMS admin and prefers BYOK with an AWS KMS CMK. Evan, please advise if we should expect a key policy change request from Redwood.

Jamie
IT Operations, Pharos Health
it-ops@pharoshealth.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the uploads. Summary & next steps:
- Kickoff complete — owners confirmed.
- Jamie: VPN test window Sept 21, 13:00–15:00 PT (Dev will send test instructions).
- Evan: Redwood will prepare a KMS BYOK integration doc and proposed key policy changes (Priyom + Dev to review).
- Laura: deliverables by Sept 20 (staging runbook, firewall template).
- Procurement: Natalie, we will send an updated MAP + draft SOW for procurement review by Sept 20 — DocuSign link will follow.

I’ll track progress in the MAP worksheet and update milestones as each deliverable lands. +1 if the summary looks right and we’ll keep the thread here for record.

Best,
Vivek
